create or replace function public.office_client_birthdays(p_month integer)
returns table(id uuid,first_name text,last_name text,phone text,date_of_birth date,assigned_agent_id uuid,status text,birthday_day integer)
language sql stable security invoker
set search_path = pg_catalog, public
as $function$
 select c.id,c.first_name,c.last_name,c.phone,c.date_of_birth,c.assigned_agent_id,c.status::text,extract(day from c.date_of_birth)::integer
 from public.clients c
 where p_month between 1 and 12 and c.date_of_birth is not null
 and c.status is distinct from 'deceased'
 and extract(month from c.date_of_birth)=p_month
 order by extract(day from c.date_of_birth),lower(c.last_name),lower(c.first_name),c.id
$function$;
revoke all on function public.office_client_birthdays(integer) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.office_client_birthdays(integer) to service_role;
